title: Pac-Man Game
subtitle: Java Arcade Recreation
description: A Java recreation of the classic Pac-Man arcade game featuring responsive player movement, intelligent ghost AI pathfinding, collectible pellets, real-time score calculation, and robust collision detection.

title: Google Dino Game
subtitle: Chrome Offline Runner Clone
description: A Java clone of Chrome's offline dinosaur runner game featuring gravity-based jumping physics, randomly generated obstacle generation, procedural speed scaling, and live score tracking.

title: Library Management System
subtitle: Console-Based C++ OOP Application
description: Robust desktop console application architected in C++ using advanced Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) paradigms including classes, inheritance, and encapsulation. Handles book inventories, student member records, issue/return transactions, and persistent file-based storage.

title: Car Rental System
subtitle: C++ Vehicle Booking & Billing System
description: Comprehensive C++ management system for vehicle fleet administration, customer profiling, reservation scheduling, and dynamic rental fee computation. Implemented with clean modular classes ensuring separation of concerns and data integrity.

title: Modern Personal Portfolio Website
subtitle: React, Vite & Tailwind CSS Showcase
description: A fast, fully responsive, and accessible personal portfolio website built with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. Features a dynamic typing hero, dark/light theme switching, modular data architecture, and an EmailJS-powered contact channel.
